parameters.subject: OpportunityOS setup test - outgoing email
parameters.text:
This is a setup test from OpportunityOS.

If you can read this message, n8n successfully sent email through the agent mailbox. No opportunity was processed and no application was submitted.

You can delete this test message after confirming receipt.

parameters.content:
## Slice 0 email delivery check
Choose OpportunityOS Email Out on the Send Email node. Execute manually once, then confirm receipt in the agent mailbox. SMTP acceptance does not prove inbox delivery. No other recipient, AI call, or database write. Do not publish this test. Each manual execution sends another test email; retries are disabled.
